**The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild**

It is the definitive modern Nintendo experience: a masterclass in open-world freedom where curiosity is the primary mechanic. You can go anywhere, do anything, and the world reacts to you. It captures the pure "Nintendo magic" of playful discovery better than almost any other game in the last decade.
